UPDATE bot.reaction_role_mappings
               SET guild_id = $1,
                   source_channel_id = $2,
                   message_id = $3,
                   emoji = $4,
                   role_id = $5,
                   dm_enabled = $6,
                   dm_text = $7,
                   remove_on_unreact = $8,
                   backfill_pending = $9,
                   active = TRUE,
                   updated_at = $10
             WHERE id = $11
